scope: relocation, frozen hashes, raw saved reference audit, finite prediction and gate replay, metrics, lightweight tests; no new native reference integration or scientific refit

command:
import run_study as s
import json,numpy as np,pandas as pd
f=pd.read_csv("new_candidates.csv",float_precision="round_trip")
m=s.read(s.ROOT/"outputs/development/models.json")
p=s.all_predict(f,m,finite=True)[["candidate_id","model","predicted_peak"]]
e=pd.read_csv("frozen_predictions.csv",float_precision="round_trip")
z=p.merge(e,on=["candidate_id","model"],validate="one_to_one",suffixes=("_replay","_frozen"))
err=float(np.max(np.abs(z.predicted_peak_replay-z.predicted_peak_frozen)))
raw=int(((z.predicted_peak_replay<=4.)!=z.raw_compliant).sum())
release=(z.predicted_peak_replay+z.buffer_mgN_L<4.)&z.in_joint_domain&z.in_feature_domain
reject=(z.predicted_peak_replay-z.buffer_mgN_L>4.)&z.in_joint_domain&z.in_feature_domain
gate=int(((release!=z.direct_release)|(reject!=z.direct_reject)|((~(release|reject))!=z.recheck)).sum())
result={"prediction_pairs":len(z),"maximum_absolute_difference":err,"raw_decision_differences":raw,"gate_differences":gate,"passed":len(z)==540 and err<1e-9 and raw==0 and gate==0}
print(json.dumps(result));assert result["passed"]
